note: Cooper County (Missouri) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Its largest city, Boonville, publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (June 2024); the county's assessor GIS (integritygis) lists parcels, flood and district layers but no zoning; the county says zoning is handled by the cities. No ArcGIS REST zoning service found for Cooper County or Boonville, Otterville or Pilot Grove.
